findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_site · Private data: compose_landing, add_integration, whoami, env_vars, connect_domain, check_domain, publish_landing · Public sink: compose_landing_submit, publish_landing · Destructive: env_vars, check_performance, publish_landing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_site · Private data: compose_landing, add_integration, whoami, env_vars, connect_domain, check_domain, publish_landing · Public sink: compose_landing_submit, publish_landing · Destructive: env_vars, check_performance, publish_landing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "deploy" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
